task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, take a trip south. If you can succeed at that, go east. With that done, move north. Then, go north. Next, make an attempt to take a trip east. And then, make an attempt to go south. Following that, go to the east. And then, make an attempt to take a trip south. With that done, pick up the stick of butter from the floor of the cookhouse. And once you've done that, you win!
